label: thm:every_composite_once
title: Every composite is generated exactly once
statement: During the execution of the linear sieve up to $n$, each composite number $m\le n$ is written exactly once in the table $\mathrm{lp}$.
proof: Existence of a write follows from \ref{lem:linear_decomp_exists}; uniqueness follows from \ref{lem:linear_decomp_unique}.
